page.home.description: Launchpad for the active Koali Space
page.health.description: Health of the Koali presentation layer
page.offline.description: Local availability declared by admitted surfaces
page.settings.title: Presentation settings
page.tasks.description: Aggregated work queue supplied by admitted owners
home.surface_description: Interface surface admitted by the active Space.
offline.explanation: The local shell remains available according to the last validated Space. Each route keeps its own offline declaration; an application is never considered offline-capable merely because it appears in Koali.
settings.presentation_only_description: Roles, capabilities, services, credentials, and internal application settings remain with their owners.
settings.persistence_note: These preferences are stored locally on this device and remain separate from Space activation, capabilities, and business data.
tasks.empty: No task projected by admitted owners
surface.timeout_description: The admitted target did not finish loading within the bounded timeout. Koali never switches origins or providers automatically.
surface.access_description: The active presentation policy does not allow this surface. Koali Spaces does not override the owner authorization boundary.
surface.application_unavailable_descript: The registered application runtime is missing or failed. No alternate provider is selected automatically.
surface.application_not_ready_descriptio: The application runtime is not ready yet. Runtime lifecycle remains owned by the declared owner or kOA lifecycle boundary.
